newsitem.title: USA: Roper to make 2 acquisitions for $62.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Roper to make 2 acquisitions for $62.4 mln.

text.p: Roper Industries Inc said Thursday that it has signed definitive agreements for two acquisitions for about $62.4 million in cash and stock.

Roper said it will acquire Princeton Instruments Inc for $37.4 million in cash and $3.0 million in Roper stock and Petrotech Inc for $6.5 million in cash and $6.5 million in Roper stock, with the assumption of about $9 million of debt.
Princeton, which designs, manufactures and markets spectral and digital imaging cameras, had revenues of $34.0 million for the twelve months ended April 30, 1997.

Petrotech, which provides system integration of control products and systems for turbines and compressors within the oil & gas, pipeline, process control and power generation markets, had revenues of $31.0 million for the twelve months ended April 30, 1997.
Roper also said that it has negotiated a new credit facility of $200 million.

The company said it believes this new credit facility, which replaces its former credit facility of $100 million, will be sufficient to meet general corporate and future acquisition financing requirements.
